remedy: rank resolution attacked directly: the counted-instrument sweep refined from 15 to 25 levels at the commissioned anchor seed 400; the SAME 10 added levels rendered at replica seeds 401/402 so the replicate spread of the validity statistic is measured AT THE REFINED DENSITY

readings_frozen.margin_exceeds_spread_VALID: the verdict stands as measured VALID; the counted tracking (already 1i-ADEQUATE) completes the 1h/1d trigger; ALL THREE diffuse pairs FAIL, committed, no substitute channel, N = 0
readings_frozen.margin_exceeds_spread_DEGENERATE: the sweep is degenerate; it carries no information either direction; the three PASS_WITH_UNTESTED_DRIVER verdicts stand (with their Phase-2 adequacy marks); N = 3
readings_frozen.margin_still_within_spread: ADEQUACY_PRECONDITION_UNMET stands at the refined density; Phase 4 records the contingency: the three pairs take PASS_CONTINGENT_ON_UNRESOLVED_INSTRUMENT, strictly worse than PASS_WITH_UNTESTED_DRIVER, carried by every downstream reference
readings_frozen.qualification_shift: axis span qualification is re-checked per seed at 25 levels BEFORE any rho is read; if refinement changes which axes qualify, that is said first and the validity statistic is computed on the refined qualifying set

validity_statistic: min |rho| over qualifying-axis pairs vs the 0.80 ceiling; deciding margin = |min_rho - 0.80| at seed 400; spread = max over replica seeds of |min_rho_seed - min_rho_400| computed on the same qualifying-axis pair as seed 400's minimum
